title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

reading.body:
Waymo's autonomous vehicles were not designed for the battery endurance required to sit in standstill traffic for extended periods during major disruptions. When severe gridlock followed Fourth of July celebrations in San Francisco, at least a dozen vehicles drained their batteries while stationary on city streets, requiring some to be towed. This is a system deployed without sufficient margin for foreseeable but irregular conditions: a major holiday celebration near popular landmarks can reliably be expected to generate traffic anomalies, yet the vehicles lacked either the battery capacity or the decision logic to preemptively relocate or shut down.

The incident also shows failures in operational awareness during unusual conditions. One vehicle drove through an intersection where fireworks were being set off, suggesting the system did not detect or appropriately respond to hazards from the environment. Another vehicle caught fire after driving over fireworks. These represent either sensor blindness to a foreseeable hazard in a dense urban area during a major holiday, or a failure to route vehicles away from predictably dangerous zones when normal traffic patterns broke down.

It is not established whether the battery drain, the encounter with fireworks, or the vehicle fire resulted from the same root cause or separate failures in the system's perception, planning, or operational design.

reports.title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

summary:
During Fourth of July celebrations in San Francisco on Saturday, several Waymo autonomous vehicles became stranded after their batteries drained while stuck in heavy traffic following a fireworks display near the Golden Gate Bridge. Video footage showed at least a dozen Waymo vehicles, primarily Jaguar I-PACE models, lined up stationary on city streets, with some requiring towing assistance. The company attributed the situation to major traffic disruptions, high volumes of travelers, and unexpected road closures that created severe congestion in the area.

The incident caused frustration among other motorists stuck in traffic, with some spending nearly two hours in standstill conditions. One passenger reported that her Waymo continued driving through an intersection where someone was setting off fireworks. Additionally, a Waymo vehicle caught fire after driving over fireworks, though no injuries were reported. Waymo stated it is evaluating ways to improve resilience during major traffic disruptions, while San Francisco's mayor's office said it will discuss the event with public and private partners to prevent similar delays in the future.
